description:
Goal
Delete the old root artifact ladder that .16.9 should have removed: MaterializeRoot, DeriveAbiReady, DeriveEmissionReady, LowerBackendProgram, and their root projection stores/tests/docs. Native, macro, and dump front doors must not keep the ladder alive.

Signal
rg shows no production Job variants or FactKey variants for the old ladder, no MaterializedProgram/AbiReadyProgram/EmissionReadyProgram root stores, and product-backed interp/native/macro paths still pass. Unsupported dump stages are removed or product-backed; no old-stage drive remains.

Strategy
Cut remaining consumers to product BackendProgram first, retire obsolete dump stages, delete ladder jobs/stores/tests/docs, then prove with focused tests, rg, clippy, and telemetry on fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz.
title: Remove legacy root artifact ladder after pull backend cutover
